request: Critically review the current README.md and identify weaknesses, gaps, unclear areas, and missing sections. Then improve it to be production-grade documentation with clear differentiation, limitations, and real-world usage clarity.
title: Review and enhance README.md for production-grade quality
goals: Identify weaknesses, gaps, and unclear areas in the current README.md
Determine missing sections that are essential for production-grade documentation

success_criteria: All identified weaknesses, gaps, and unclear areas are addressed
